headline: Nevish Line Leads Renewed Front-Line Struggle
war_summary: The latest ledger puts Nevish Line and Linn Mercy once more at the head of the fighting, though the tempo has shifted since the previous edition. Nevish Line shows five base events in two hours and 63 across the day, with seven Colonial holdings and one neutral position in the current snapshot; its casualty and enlistment rates are rising against the immediately preceding window. Linn Mercy records five recent events and 42 daily, remaining at ten Colonial bases and one neutral, while its Colonial casualty rate accelerates even as Warden losses cool. Callahans Passage has gone quiet in the last two hours but logged five events in six and 19 in 24, leaving all ten bases Warden-held. Weathered Expanse likewise has no fresh short-watch event, yet 39 daily changes leave seven Warden bases and two neutral. Mooring County has two events in six hours and 16 in the day, with ten Warden and two Colonial holdings. Marban Hollow is presently still after 11 daily events, retaining a divided four-Warden, three-Colonial, one-neutral ledger. The sharpest immediate ownership watch therefore remains Nevish Line and Linn Mercy, with Callahans Passage and Mooring County the next active ledgers.
